query: Simular las ventas diarias de una plataforma de comercio electrónico en expansión durante un año. Dominio: Retail y Ventas. Variable estricta: Únicamente 'Ventas_Diarias'. Perfil matemático: P3_TENDENCIA_ESTACIONAL, con tendencia creciente sostenida y ciclos semanales marcados por mayor consumo en fines de semana. Escala: promedio inicial de 2500 USD creciendo hacia 4000 USD.

structured_prompt.justification: The time series will be used to simulate the daily sales of an online store during a year. The sales are expected to increase over time due to the store's expansion. The weekends will have higher sales due to increased online shopping.
structured_prompt.suggested_search: Time series analysis of online sales with a trend and weekly seasonality
structured_prompt.search_strategy: Use a time series model with a trend component and a weekly seasonality component to simulate the sales data.
